## Survey plan and sequence
1. Capture recursive file/directory metadata.
2. Classify client, server, tools, third-party libraries, build outputs, and data.
3. Inspect selected source/build files with secret-bearing content excluded.
4. Inventory loose and packed asset formats; hash selected CDN PAK/APK files only.
5. Compare static source references to loose files and mark archive-dependent references unresolved.
